About

Borrowed Tongues is a music project that takes songs from constructed languages — the invented tongues of fictional worlds — and pairs them with genres that fit their culture. Every lyric is adapted from public domain literature. Every language is real, in the sense that someone built grammar rules and a vocabulary and a community of speakers grew up around it.

Music is generated with AI assistance (Suno). Translations are assisted by AI and reviewed against published grammars. Source texts are entirely public domain. The project treats constructed languages with the same respect it treats the source material — as real creative work worth engaging with seriously.
